_comment: Local machine settings for the Windows-only dev tools (scripts/trade_dashboard.py, scripts/ea_shim.py, packaging/dashboard/, scripts/generate-dev-certs.py). Copy to config.json (gitignored) and edit for your machine. This is NOT how apps/* services are configured -- those read .env / process env, see .env.example. Never put real MT5 login/password pairs here; the Windows local stack authenticates against whichever MT5 terminal is already logged in, it does not read credentials from this file.
